shared_elements: large plumed/feathered headdress with radiating elements
profile faces with prominent curved noses and scroll-like details
densely packed relief composition filling the whole field
zoomorphic mask heads incorporated into regalia
justification: Both surfaces depict richly costumed human figures whose faces emerge from enormous composite headdresses built of zoomorphic masks, scrolls and radiating plumes, with the field densely filled by interlocking curvilinear regalia elements — a specific and conventional combination rather than a generic figure. The main difference is that A is a low, incised, largely linear multi-figure scene arranged horizontally, while B is a single deep-relief standing figure organized vertically with a frontal face, headdress above and body/ornaments below, so the compositional format differs even though the vocabulary of forms corresponds.
